name: river_sword

Sword fully visible in each cell: slim sharp steel blade, simple crossguard, dark leather grip and small round pommel, no hand/person. Blade points UP, hilt at bottom, sword rigid, same shape, same x center and same bottom baseline in all frames; do not rotate or stretch it. Four subtle looping phases of a very faint pale icy edge glint and tiny water ripple around bottom, without a large light aura. Solid sword readable even without glow; no flames, spark cloud, fog cloud, scenery or ground slab. Pixel density and cold metal shading match attached game prop; upper-left highlights, dark blue-grey outlines, <=40 colors. True transparent background, hard square pixels, no antialiasing, no text or frame borders, 2 pixel clear margins. At game scale blade should be 4-6px wide, whole sword about52px tall and crossguard20px wide, faint light never obscures steel. Four unique 8fps loop frames.
